claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Fludroxycortide is a potent glucocorticoid receptor agonist; at 2.5 uM it is expected to induce glucocorticoid receptor-mediated apoptosis/cytostasis selectively in sensitive hematopoietic/lymphoid cancer lines, with little effect on most solid tumor lines.
